change: Verified catalog comparisons map each affected kind to deterministic model identifiers for additions, removals and changed models classified before and after a kind transition.

semantics.added: current-catalog model identifiers introduced under the kind
semantics.removed: previous-catalog model identifiers removed from the kind
semantics.changedBefore: changed model identifiers classified by their previous kind
semantics.changedAfter: changed model identifiers classified by their current kind
semantics.emptyKinds: omitted from driftModelIdsByKind; unchanged and source-revision-only reports expose an empty object
